modules.title: 同一个 head 信息被谁读取

items.title: 字段放在 head，结果出现在不同地方
items.text: title 影响浏览器标签，description 可能帮助形成搜索摘要，Open Graph 字段服务链接预览，Manifest 描述安装入口。它们都与正文有关，但不是正文内容本身。

items.title: 按消费方验收实际结果
items.text: 先问“谁会读这项信息”，再检查字段、资源地址和最终显示。某一处正常，只能证明对应消费者读到了可用信息。

modules.title: 它不是一张万能配置表
modules.text: {c:page-metadata} 是总类，不会自动替代 {c:title-tag}、{c:open-graph} 或 {c:web-app-manifest}。分享卡缺图时检查分享字段，安装后启动路径错误时检查 Manifest，不要笼统重写正文。

lessonPractice.title: 页面在浏览器标签里标题正常，但分享卡没有图片，应该先修哪里？

options.label: 检查分享平台读取的元数据，补齐对应的分享图片并用真实预览复测
options.feedback: 对。不同消费方读取不同字段，标签页正常不能证明分享卡的图片字段存在或可访问。

options.label: 重写正文第一段，让分享平台从页面正文里自动找一张图片
options.feedback: 正文内容不等于分享元数据，不能替代对分享卡输入字段的检查。

options.label: 更换 Favicon，因为所有页面图像都由它决定
options.feedback: Favicon 主要服务浏览器识别站点，不是分享卡的主图字段。

en.title: The browser tab title is correct, but a shared link has no image. Where should you look first?

options.label: Inspect metadata read by sharing platforms, add the matching image, and retest with a real preview
options.feedback: Correct. Consumers read different fields, so a correct tab title does not prove that the share image exists or is reachable.

options.label: Rewrite the first paragraph so the platform can automatically find an image in the body
options.feedback: Page content is not the same as sharing metadata and cannot replace checking the fields that feed the preview card.

options.label: Change the Favicon because every page image comes from it
options.feedback: A Favicon mainly identifies the site in browser surfaces; it is not the main image field for a share card.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请按浏览器标签、搜索摘要、链接分享和安装入口分别列出当前页面的元数据，缺什么只补对应字段。用浏览器源码、搜索结果和真实分享预览分别验收，不要把“metadata 已完成”当作一个无需拆分的结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: List this page's metadata separately for the browser tab, search snippet, shared link, and install entry, and add only the missing field for each consumer. Verify with page source, search output, and a real share preview; do not treat metadata as one indivisible completion flag.

references.title: 控制搜索结果中的摘要
references.title_en: Control your snippets in search results

learning.assumes: You have seen a browser tab, a search result, or a link preview in a chat.
learning.outcome: You can split page metadata checks by browser, search, sharing, and installation instead of treating one successful field as proof that everything is complete.

modules.title: Who reads information from one head
How page metadata divides the job

items.title: Head fields produce different results
items.text: The title affects the browser tab, a description may help form a search snippet, Open Graph fields feed a link preview, and a Manifest describes an install entry. They relate to the body but are not body content.

items.title: Verify each consumer's actual result
items.text: Ask who reads a field, then check the field, resource URL, and final presentation. A correct one only proves that its corresponding consumer received usable information.

modules.title: It is not one universal configuration table
modules.text: {c:page-metadata} is the broad category; it does not replace {c:title-tag}, {c:open-graph}, or {c:web-app-manifest}. A missing share image needs share fields, while a wrong installed launch path needs the Manifest.

distinctions.label: Open Graph
distinctions.text: {c:page-metadata} is the broad group of head information; {c:open-graph} specifically describes a shared-link card's title, description, image, and URL.

distinctions.label: Title Tag
distinctions.text: {c:title-tag} is one concrete title field in page metadata; {c:page-metadata} also covers information for search, sharing, and installation.
